guide.summary: Lets microbes of the same kind hold on to each other and form small chains.
guide.biology: Some real bacteria stick together when they meet or after they divide, forming chains and clumps.
guide.rules: Costs 0.02 energy per second while carried. Two free, active carriers of the same kind that stay within 0.5 cells for 5 seconds, both with at least 20 energy, may link for 2 energy each. Each has at most 2 links and a colony at most 8 members. Linked members stop swimming and pay 0.01 energy per second per link. Links share nothing unless both ends also carry Exchange junction. A link breaks after 10 seconds without food, below 15 energy, on resting, capture, division, sampling or death, when a gate is placed between them, or when pulled more than 0.75 cells apart; then it cannot relink for 10 seconds. Newborns start unlinked. Cannot be combined with Settler.
guide.example: Release a crowd of linking Sprinters and watch small chains form, then break apart as food runs out.
